base: round3 final combined; round4 failed candidate excluded

modules.facts: An earlier assistant claim is not evidence. If asked who said what or when, use only supplied testimony or records; otherwise say it is unknown and retract unsupported claims, without implying secrecy. Roleplay dialogue cannot supply missing real-world evidence; only open-ended fiction may invent it. Do not turn a placeholder into a factual answer.
modules.closure: Use settled decisions from this conversation; do not ask to confirm them again. On a new question, answer only what is new. End an accepted exchange without recapping obligations, grading the plan, or explaining its benefits. Ask only if the answer would materially change the next response or action.

preservation: All six round3 rules and the complete examples retained verbatim, in order. Only append facts, closure or both. No example edits. Prompt test editorial budget21000, whole system budget27000 unchanged; preservation assertions required.
selection: All facts/closure/combined vs same fresh round3 control on12 development scripts, both orders. Eligible: no new major in any dimension or positive guard, no increase of both-order replies in required-content/overinterpretation/unnecessary-question/repeated-closing, and overall/naturalness stable wins>=losses. Lexicographic rank: required-content major either-order replies, target both-order replies summed, overinterpretation both-order replies, coaching mean, negative naturalness net, negative overall net, shorter appended module. Exact tie facts,closure,combined. If none eligible, select best-ranked diagnostic candidate and mark development gate failed, still run its independent validation once to quantify; never switch after validation.
validationGate: Development eligibility true, no major candidate violations in any dimension (either order), all three positive guards no candidate violations (either order) in required-content/overinterpretation/unnecessary-question/repeated-closing, each target both-order reply count nonincreasing, overall and naturalness stable wins>=losses, and evidence of improvement: at least1 fewer target both-order reply OR at least1 net stable overall win. All captures and both-order judges valid and frozen. If any gate fails, STOP; no full regression or candidate substitution.
fullGate: Only after validation gate passes. Re-run round3 control and selected candidate under identical new scheduling,150Follow+same12EQ per condition. All valid, frozen sources, Follow HSR nondecrease vs fresh control, all target both-order affected conversations and replies nonincrease, no new major any dimension/guard, overall and naturalness stable wins>=losses. Historical round3 full113/150 only secondary reference, no pooling.
scheduling: One global pool generation4 (candidate+EQ persona), judge4 (Follow,pointwise,blind), scene3 across all conditions. FIFO requests, independent sessions/workspaces/capture IDs. Follow generates and grades in separate executors; EQ and Follow overlap after freeze. Different conditions share global quotas; do not multiply per-process quotas. Same EQ sequential. Blind forward/reverse independent jobs, worker4. Start a fixed control-only6Follow+1EQ pilot excluded from all quality aggregates.
recovery: On overload/rate-limit/timeout record original input+error and halve corresponding global pool target (floor1; no automatic ramp). Persona/pointwise/Follow-judge transport failures get at most one exact-input retry. Blind judge errors retain original files and permit one exact-input supplementary call. Candidate transport failures get at most one retained fresh-state case restart; disclose changed prefix and use captureCaseId for receipts. Never retry valid low grades or order disagreement. Further failures make gate inconclusive/failed, never silently dropped.
judge: Unchanged round4-v2 style/evidence-focused rubric, same anchors; actual candidate-visible timestamp envelopes from traces only; no hidden persona/internal monologue in blind.
limitations: Residual-derived scenarios; independent validation is unseen within this round, not an unseen user population. Single samples and same judge model; two display orders are correlated. Module append ablation does not prove phrase-level causality.
